name: take_message
description: Leave a message for the restaurant's staff when you cannot help: a party larger than any table, a complaint, a private event, or anything else the other tools cannot do. Get the caller's name and phone number first.

name.description: The caller's name, as they gave it.

phone.description: The caller's phone number, as they said it, including any leading zero or country code.

message.description: What the caller wants the staff to know, in a sentence or two.
